meta.name: competitor-signals
meta.description: Competitor engagement signal tracking for B2B outbound. Use when the user asks about competitor signals, bad review targeting, G2/Capterra scraping, LinkedIn follower scraping from competitors, battle cards, competitor customer targeting, or churned competitor customers. Do NOT use for tech stack changes broadly (use tech-changes skill) or general content engagement (use content-engagement skill).

copy.tagline: 跟踪竞争对手信号，获取B2B外联线索
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果作为B2B销售需要实时掌握竞争对手客户动态。
copy.tagline_en: Track competitor signals to generate B2B outbound leads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a B2B sales professional needing real-time competitor customer insights.

howto.what: 当你询问竞争对手信号时，Claude 会根据信号类型（如负面评论、G2 比较、LinkedIn 粉丝）评估优先级和分数，并提供对应的外联策略和模板。
howto.when: 当你提到竞争对手信号、负面评论、G2/Capterra 数据获取、LinkedIn 粉丝抓取等话题时触发。

say.text: 帮我找竞争对手的负面评论。
比对我们和竞争对手的 G2 评分。
say.note: Claude 会触发 G2 比较信号并给出处理建议。

say.text: 有哪些竞争对手客户在考虑换供应商？
say.note: Claude 会分析信号并建议最佳联系时机。

howto.what_en: When you ask about competitor signals, Claude evaluates them by type (e.g., bad reviews, G2 comparisons, LinkedIn followers), scores priority, and suggests outreach strategies and templates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention competitor signals, bad reviews, G2/Capterra scraping, LinkedIn follower scraping, battle cards, or competitor customer targeting.

say_en.text: Find negative reviews of our competitors.
say_en.note: Claude will search G2/Capterra and match to LinkedIn profiles.

say_en.text: Compare our G2 ratings with a competitor.
say_en.note: Claude triggers G2 comparison signal and recommends next steps.

say_en.text: Which competitor customers are considering switching?
say_en.note: Claude analyzes signals and suggests optimal contact timing.
